name: QE24 Dynamic Page Probe
author: HackHub Quest Editor
description: QA probe for SDK 0.24 dynamic website pages, r246 rebuild: one static control page and seven dynamic pages on qe24-dyn.test. Compared with 1.0.0 the beat is now fired by the 'qedyn beat' terminal command instead of an Http.Response that never arrives (r241/r242), Http.Response is logged BEFORE any host filter so 'no event' and 'unexpected host' can be told apart, and /form now prints what Mail.send returned and offers a second button that goes through the documented Events.emit bridge (r245: the quest's own mail arrives, a page's does not). Type 'qedyn status' for everything the probe recorded. Claim QEDynProbeQuest and follow its objectives - they are the QA checklist. Nothing auto-starts.
